events.description: Creation and side-by-side arrangement of Document A (pink/magenta blocks) and Document B (green blocks) with their respective labels.
events.clip_query: Two documents labeled Document A and Document B made of stacked colored rectangles appear side by side.

events.description: A snippet of Document B is copied and combined with a copy of Document A to form a combined document on the right using curved paths.
events.clip_query: A portion of the green document and the pink document fly together along curved paths to form a combined document.

events.description: The combined document is visually compressed (shrunk and flattened) and labeled 'GZIP(AB)'.
events.clip_query: The combined document shrinks and flattens into a compressed block labeled GZIP(AB).

events.description: Document A is copied, compressed individually, labeled 'GZIP(A)', and both compressed blocks are centered side-by-side with vertical lines.
events.clip_query: Two compressed blocks labeled GZIP(AB) and GZIP(A) are aligned side-by-side with vertical lines next to them.
